text:
marisa: Quick pass — we need final copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages before dev handoff EOD tomorrow. Focus: hero line, 1-line benefit, CTA text, and inbound lead routing rules. Also need one short benchmark blurb and a webinar CTA. Drop suggestions here.

tariq: For hero lines, my first draft: Hosted: 'API-first LLM inference, instant scale.' Dedicated: 'Reserved GPU capacity, predictable performance.' Private: 'Self-hosted inference with enterprise controls.'

eden: Like those. Slight tweak to make them product-y: Hosted -> 'Hosted API for devs who want immediate scale.' Dedicated -> 'Dedicated capacity for steady throughput and SLAs.' Private -> 'Private deployment for regulated workloads & VPC control.'

jess: Routing note: leads from /pricing/enterprise or form flag "enterprise=true" -> route to sales@ + create high-touch SDR ticket. Self-serve trials -> growth@. Webinar signups -> marketing-webinars@. Example rule we can paste to devs:

```
if (lead.segment == 'enterprise' || url.includes('/pricing/enterprise')) {
  route: 'sales'
} else if (lead.source == 'webinar') {
  route: 'marketing-webinars'
} else {
  route: 'growth'
}
```

marisa: Nice. For the one-line benefits per mode we should emphasize the deciding tradeoff: time-to-value (Hosted), predictability & isolation (Dedicated), compliance & network control (Private). Can someone write 10-12 word lines?

tariq: Hosted: 'Start with a hosted API — fast onboarding, pay-as-you-go scale.'

eden: Dedicated: 'Reserved GPU pools — consistent throughput, burst options, SLA-backed uptime.'

jess: Private: 'Customer-managed deployment — VPC, KMS, and on-prem options for compliance.'

marisa: Perfect. Now benchmark blurb (20-30 words) for the benchmarks section that ties to page copy: something we can A/B test that calls out latency & cost.

tariq: "Benchmarks show median gen latency under 60ms for common prompts on Dedicated, with up to 4x cost savings vs naive single-request setups when using batching+cache." — that is slightly long but we can trim.

eden: Trimmed: "Median generation latency <60ms on Dedicated; batching + caching can cut per-token cost by up to 4x versus single-request baselines." (27 words)

marisa: Good. Webinar CTA: short 6-10 words. Ideas?

copybot: Variant A: 'See inference economics in action — join our webinar.' Variant B: 'Live demo: optimize LLM costs & latency.' Variant C: 'Webinar: deploy reliable, low-cost LLM inference.'

jess: For CTAs on the page I recommend two-tier CTAs: Primary = 'Start free' for Hosted and Dedicated trial pages; Secondary = 'Contact sales' for Private + Dedicated enterprise. Eg: Primary text variants to A/B: 'Start free', 'Get started — free credits', 'Try Hosted API'.

eden: Also include a small persistent banner for compliance audience: 'Need private deployment? Contact sales to discuss VPC or on-prem.' Keep it link-based, not modal.

marisa: OK — action items:
- tariq: finalize hero + 1-line benefit versions (three each) by 11:30am
- eden: pick CTAs and banner copy, + webinar blurb final by 12:00pm
- jess: confirm routing JSON and send to eng with examples (include form flags)
- copybot: generate A/B variants for primary CTA (3) and webinar CTA (3)

jess: I'll create the PR with final copy assets and label with /dev-handoff. Ping me when you're done.

marisa: Thanks team — this is the last pass. If no major objections I'll push copy into the content repo at 14:00 and tag eng for the handoff. :raised_hands:

copybot: Noted — generating assets now. Will post files in #marketing-dropbox.

eden: quick note: for Dedicated page let's add one sentence about autoscaling & burst capacity under the benefits bullet.

tariq: good call — will add: 'Configurable autoscaling with burst capacity for spike handling.'

marisa: Great. That's everything I needed. If you see phrasing that leans too technical, keep it approachable — product managers will scrub later.
